radar.title: Screenshot check is here
radar.body: Share any screenshot of a message to Jemixo Safe. The text is read on the phone and checked for scam patterns, in English and Hindi.

radar.title: "Digital arrest" video calls
radar.body: Callers posing as police, CBI or customs claim a parcel in your name has drugs and keep you on a video call while you transfer money. No agency arrests anyone over a call. Hang up and dial 1930.

radar.title: Instant loan apps that harass
radar.body: Apps outside the Play Store lend small amounts, then use your contacts and photos to threaten you. Only borrow through apps run by RBI-regulated lenders, and never install a loan APK from a link.

radar.title: "Refund" UPI requests
radar.body: A stranger sends a UPI collect request or QR saying it is a refund or a prize. Approving it sends your money out. You never need to enter a PIN to receive money.

radar.title: Electricity bill disconnection SMS
radar.body: Messages from a 10-digit number say your power will be cut tonight and ask you to call an "officer". Real utility SMS come from a registered sender ID, never a personal number.

radar.title: WhatsApp / Telegram "trading tips" groups
radar.body: Groups with fake screenshots of profits push an app or link to invest. The dashboard shows gains, but withdrawals never work. SEBI-registered brokers never onboard through chat groups.

radar.title: APK files sent on WhatsApp
radar.body: "Wedding invitation", "traffic challan" or "bank update" APKs read your SMS and drain accounts. Never install an APK from a chat; share it to Jemixo Safe first.

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.note: Report within the first hour to freeze the money

callRules.note: Indian banks, courier companies and government offices never call from foreign numbers. 140-series numbers are telemarketers; 1600-series numbers are verified service calls (TRAI).
